functions.name: fn_wp10_batch_size_state_as_of
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION costing.fn_wp10_batch_size_state_as_of(p_product_id bigint, p_as_of date)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'costing', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select case when exists (
    select 1 from public.production_batch_size_ref b
    where b.product_id = p_product_id
      and b.is_active
      and b.effective_from <= p_as_of
      and (b.effective_to is null or b.effective_to >= p_as_of)
  ) then 'RESOLVED' else 'MISSING' end
$function$

functions.name: fn_wp10_boundary_dates
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION costing.fn_wp10_boundary_dates(p_sku_id bigint, p_product_id bigint, p_from date, p_to date)
 RETURNS date[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'costing', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  with product as (
    select p.id, p.sub_group_id, sg.product_group_id
    from public.products p left join public.sub_groups sg on sg.id = p.sub_group_id
    where p.id = p_product_id
  ),
  families as (
    select m.route_family_id as id from costing.production_route_family_product_map m where m.product_id = p_product_id
    union select sm.route_family_id from costing.production_route_family_product_subgroup_map sm join product pr on pr.sub_group_id = sm.product_subgroup_id
    union select gm.route_family_id from costing.production_route_family_product_group_map gm join product pr on pr.product_group_id = gm.product_group_id
  ),
  edges(d_from, d_to) as (
    select r.effective_from, r.effective_to from public.plm_bom_revision r where r.sku_id = p_sku_id and r.status in ('APPROVED', 'SUPERSEDED')
    union all select b.effective_from, b.effective_to from public.production_batch_size_ref b where b.product_id = p_product_id and b.is_active
    union all select p.effective_from, p.effective_to from costing.sku_mrp_policy p where p.sku_id = p_sku_id and p.status = 'APPROVED'
    union all select p.effective_from, p.effective_to from costing.sku_selling_price_policy p where p.sku_id = p_sku_id and p.is_active
    union all select f.effective_from, f.effective_to from costing.production_route_family f where f.id in (select id from families) and f.archived_at is null and f.status = 'APPROVED'
    union all select fr.effective_from, fr.effective_to from costing.production_route_family_route fr where fr.route_family_id in (select id from families) and fr.archived_at is null and fr.status in ('APPROVED', 'SUPERSEDED')
    union all select pr.effective_from, pr.effective_to from costing.product_process_route pr where pr.product_id = p_product_id and pr.archived_at is null and pr.status = 'APPROVED'
    union all select m.effective_from, m.effective_to from costing.production_route_family_product_map m where m.product_id = p_product_id and m.archived_at is null and m.status = 'APPROVED'
    union all select sm.effective_from, sm.effective_to from costing.production_route_family_product_subgroup_map sm join product pr on pr.sub_group_id = sm.product_subgroup_id where sm.archived_at is null and sm.status = 'APPROVED'
    union all select gm.effective_from, gm.effective_to from costing.production_route_family_product_group_map gm join product pr on pr.product_group_id = gm.product_group_id where gm.archived_at is null and gm.status = 'APPROVED'
  ),
  dates as (
    select d_from as d from edges where d_from is not null
    union select d_to + 1 from edges where d_to is not null
  )
  select coalesce(array_agg(d order by d), '{}'::date[]) from dates where d > p_from and d <= p_to
$function$

fn_wp10_resolve_effective_route_family_route_ctx
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION costing.fn_wp10_resolve_effective_route_family_route_ctx(p_product_id integer, p_as_of_date date, p_sub_group_id integer)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'costing', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  with f as (
    select costing.fn_wp10_resolve_route_family_ctx(p_product_id,p_as_of_date,p_sub_group_id) route_family_id
  )
  select r.id
  from costing.production_route_family_route r,f
  where r.route_family_id=f.route_family_id
    and r.archived_at is null
    and r.status in ('APPROVED','SUPERSEDED')
    and r.effective_from<=coalesce(p_as_of_date,current_date)
    and (r.effective_to is null or r.effective_to>=coalesce(p_as_of_date,current_date))
  order by r.effective_from desc,r.route_version desc,r.id desc
  limit 1
$function$

functions.name: fn_wp10_resolve_route_family_ctx
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION costing.fn_wp10_resolve_route_family_ctx(p_product_id integer, p_as_of_date date, p_sub_group_id integer)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'costing', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_date date := coalesce(p_as_of_date,current_date);
  v_product_family bigint;
  v_subgroup_family bigint;
  v_group_family bigint;
begin
  select m.route_family_id
  into v_product_family
  from costing.production_route_family_product_map m
  join costing.production_route_family f on f.id=m.route_family_id
  where m.product_id=p_product_id
    and m.archived_at is null
    and m.status='APPROVED'
    and m.effective_from<=v_date
    and (m.effective_to is null or m.effective_to>=v_date)
    and f.archived_at is null
    and f.status='APPROVED'
    and f.effective_from<=v_date
    and (f.effective_to is null or f.effective_to>=v_date)
  order by m.effective_from desc,m.id desc
  limit 1;

  if v_product_family is not null then
    return v_product_family;
  end if;

  select sm.route_family_id
  into v_subgroup_family
  from (select p_product_id as id, p_sub_group_id as sub_group_id) p
  join costing.production_route_family_product_subgroup_map sm
    on sm.product_subgroup_id=p.sub_group_id
   and sm.archived_at is null
   and sm.status='APPROVED'
   and sm.effective_from<=v_date
   and (sm.effective_to is null or sm.effective_to>=v_date)
  join costing.production_route_family f
    on f.id=sm.route_family_id
   and f.archived_at is null
   and f.status='APPROVED'
   and f.effective_from<=v_date
   and (f.effective_to is null or f.effective_to>=v_date)
  where p.id=p_product_id
  order by sm.effective_from desc,sm.id desc
  limit 1;

  if v_subgroup_family is not null then
    return v_subgroup_family;
  end if;

  select gm.route_family_id
  into v_group_family
  from (select p_product_id as id, p_sub_group_id as sub_group_id) p
  join public.sub_groups sg on sg.id=p.sub_group_id
  join costing.production_route_family_product_group_map gm
    on gm.product_group_id=sg.product_group_id
   and gm.archived_at is null
   and gm.status='APPROVED'
   and gm.effective_from<=v_date
   and (gm.effective_to is null or gm.effective_to>=v_date)
  join costing.production_route_family f
    on f.id=gm.route_family_id
   and f.archived_at is null
   and f.status='APPROVED'
   and f.effective_from<=v_date
   and (f.effective_to is null or f.effective_to>=v_date)
  where p.id=p_product_id
  order by gm.effective_from desc,gm.id desc
  limit 1;

  return v_group_family;
end
$function$
